name: Literature review
tagline: Screen papers against your inclusion criteria, with a quote for every call.
decisionQuestion: Should this paper be included in my literature review?

criteriaTemplate.label: Population
criteriaTemplate.value: Adults aged 18 and over. Exclude paediatric-only samples.

criteriaTemplate.label: Study type
criteriaTemplate.value: Peer-reviewed empirical studies. Exclude editorials, commentary, conference abstracts, and protocols.

criteriaTemplate.label: Outcome reported
criteriaTemplate.value: Reports at least one quantitative outcome relevant to the review question.

sampleCopy: Ten synthetic abstracts screened against a public health inclusion list.
